name: Ayurvedic Treatment of Bulged Disc

sections.ayurvedic_treatment_of_bulged_disc:
About Bulged Disc 
 A bulging disc occurs when the tough outer layer of an intervertebral disc protrudes outward into the spinal canal, without a tear or rupture. In contrast, a herniated disc involves a tear in the outer layer, allowing some of the soft inner material (nucleus pulposus) to leak out into the spinal canal. Bulged disc is a problem of vertebrae and occurs in the cervical spine (neck), thoracic spine (mid and upper back) and lumbar spine (lower back). 
 In our vertebrae, fluid is filled in the discs which act as shock absorbers and supports spinal movements. Disc problems are due to injury or old age factors. When a disc bulges towards the right or left side of the body it results in pain, weakness, and numbness in arms or legs.
sections.symptoms_of_bulged_disc:
Pain in arms and legs – If Bulged Disc in the lower back, there is intense pain in the buttocks, thigh, calf, and pain may spread up to feet. Bulged discs in the neck area result in intense pain in shoulders and arms. This pain may also run into arms or legs during coughing and sneezing. 
 Numbness – Numbness or tingling may also occur in the body parts by affected nerves. 
 Weakness – Affected nerves result in weakness like stumbling and inability to hold things.
sections.causes_associated_with_bulged_disc:
The Age factor is one of the major causes of Bulged Disc, because with age there is a gradual decrease in the water content of spinal disc. Due to this there is less flexibility in the spinal disc and they are more prone to rupture or tear with a minor twist or strain. 
 Injury, strain or an accident. 
 Wrong posture. 
 Obesity. 
 Lifting heavy objects or use of back muscle in objects lifting.

 As per Ayurvedic perspective, to manage the Bulged Disc there are various herbs present in Ayurveda. These herbs help to pacify the aggravated vata dosha and strengthen the muscles and relax the nerves in a natural way without any negative impact on health.
